title: Karwa Chauth 2026: Bollywood Outfit Ideas From Alia Bhatt to Yami Gautam
excerpt: The festival falls on Thursday, October 29, with moonrise at 8:17 pm in New Delhi. The Bollywood shortlists split between classic reds and a new lightweight school of chiffon, tissue silk and Anarkalis built for a day-long fast.
body:
• Karwa Chauth 2026 falls on Thursday, October 29 — in New Delhi the puja muhurat is 5:38–6:56 pm and moonrise is 8:17 pm, according to Drik Panchang timings reported by Vedantu; both vary by city.
  • The Bollywood shortlist spans Alia Bhatt's maroon velvet sharara, Anushka Sharma's classic red saree and Shilpa Shetty's red ruffle saree, per Inshorts.
  • The comfort-first counter-trend is lightweight: chiffon, tissue silk and organza sarees and flowing Anarkalis that survive a day-long fast, per HerZindagi's seven-look edit.
  • Pick the outfit around the fast, not just the photograph — breathable fabric, one statement jewellery piece, and styling you can keep from sargi to moonrise.

Red first, but lighter than it used to be

Karwa Chauth dressing has a house style — red, maroon and pink, gold jewellery, mehndi-dark hands — and this year's Bollywood-inspired shortlists keep the palette while changing the weight. Inshorts' roundup leads with Alia Bhatt's maroon velvet sharara and Anushka Sharma's classic red saree, and rounds out its five with Kareena Kapoor's sage green suit, Deepika Padukone's pink bandhani kurta and Shilpa Shetty's red ruffle saree — a useful spread, because it shows the festival look no longer has to mean a heavily worked lehenga.

The sharara and the bandhani kurta on that list matter for a practical reason: Karwa Chauth is a sunrise-to-moonrise fast, and an outfit has to work at the evening puja and at the moon-sighting, not just in a photograph at noon. Separates and kurta sets are easier to sit, stand and move in for hours than a structured blouse and a ten-kilo skirt.

The date and the moonrise clock

Karwa Chauth 2026 falls on Thursday, October 29. According to Vedantu's festival guide, citing Drik Panchang, the New Delhi timings are a puja muhurat of 5:38 pm to 6:56 pm and moonrise at 8:17 pm, with the fast traditionally broken after sighting the moon and offering arghya. The Chaturthi tithi runs from 1:06 am to 10:09 pm that day. Moonrise and puja timings are local — they shift from city to city, and diaspora readers in the US and Canada should check a panchang calculated for their own city rather than working from Delhi's clock.

Seven lightweight looks, actress by actress

HerZindagi's edit takes the opposite brief — the lightest version of each look — and its seven picks are specific enough to shop or recreate from a wardrobe. Alia Bhatt appears again, this time in a pink-red chiffon saree styled with silver jewellery, with the option of going dramatic with heavy jhumkas and a maang tikka. Deepika Padukone's entry is an Anarkali: a handwoven Navratan Patan Patola suit by artisan Bhawar Singh, reimagined by designer Anamika Khanna, worn at the Swadesh flagship store celebration in 2025 and styled with heavy jewellery.

Janhvi Kapoor's pick is a Manish Malhotra custom piece — a floral-embroidered pink ombre tissue silk saree, fading from light at the top to deeper pink below, with a matching off-shoulder blouse. Kareena Kapoor's second appearance is a bright fuchsia-pink floral chiffon saree from Picchika, printed with marigold clusters in orange and golden yellow against dark foliage. Ananya Panday offers the non-red option: Torani's light blue flared Anarkali with chand (moon) motifs — thematically apt for a moonrise festival — a silk organza dupatta, and a pearl choker with sapphire gemstones.

Rashmika Mandanna's look is the newly-married template done lightly: an off-white saree carried by a heavily embroidered, deep red, full-sleeved blouse, so the work sits in one piece rather than across the whole outfit. Yami Gautam closes the list in what HerZindagi calls the colour of 2026 — a cheery yellow Mishru saree with an embroidered border and a halter-neck embroidered blouse.

How to wear it for a 14-hour day

Read together, the two lists agree on the styling rules. Keep the base fabric breathable — chiffon, tissue silk, organza — and put the richness in one place: an embroidered blouse, a statement choker, heavy jhumkas. HerZindagi's closing advice is minimal jewellery and soft glam with the lighter drapes, reserving heavy jewellery for patterned Anarkalis like Deepika's. For diaspora readers observing on a workday in the US, the Anarkali and kurta-set routes are also the office-to-puja routes: no draping to redo, nothing that needs a second pair of hands at 6 pm.

Karwa Chauth is, as HerZindagi puts it, about love, tradition and looking your best — the 2026 version of that is simply a look you can still be comfortable in when the moon finally rises.
